work_experience.description: Developed features for DrawKids application using Swift, SwiftUI, Firebase, and Huawei Cloud DB. Contributed to enhancing app functionality and user experience for mobile platforms.

Developed and optimized Drawing Desk VR, a VR drawing practice app available on Meta Quest Store and PICO App Store, by enhancing interactivity and leading the adaptation for PICO devices. Contributed to Graffity Art Drawing app by optimizing sound profiles, implementing scene switching, creating spray presets, and adding artwork saving functionality. Worked with Unity and C# to create immersive VR experiences.

projects.name: Best Body Japan (BBJ)
projects.description: Main developer of a SwiftUI mobile application for a fitness competition platform, built as part of the Associate Software Engineer role at 4Axis Technologies. The app enables users to participate in fitness competitions, track progress, and engage with the community.

projects.name: Drawing Desk VR
projects.description: Converted the Drawing Desk VR application for PICO VR, implemented new features, and fixed bugs to improve stability and overall user experience.

projects.name: Microservices E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Led development of a microservices-based e-commerce platform with customer-facing frontend, admin dashboard, and Spring Boot backend services. Implemented order processing system with real-time inventory tracking and built admin dashboard with analytics, product management, and customer management features.

projects.name: Anothershot - Photography Web Application
projects.description: A platform for discovering, booking, and paying photographers online, featuring interactive portfolios and community engagement. Integrated payment gateway, set up Cloudinary for image management, and converted the app into a PWA to boost accessibility and user engagement.

expanding my technical versatility.
